text.body:
piṇḍē uggama uppāyaṇēsaṇā jōyaṇā pamāṇē ya
iṅgāla dhūma kāraṇa aṭṭhavihā piṇḍanijjutti // PiṇḍNi.1
---------------------------------------------------------------------
piṇḍa nikāya samūhē sampiṇḍaṇa piṇḍaṇā ya samavāē
samusaraṇa nicaya uvacaya caē ya jummē ya rāsī ya // PiṇḍNi.2
---------------------------------------------------------------------
piṇḍassa u nikkhēvō caukkaō chakkaō va kāyavvō
nikkhēvaṁ kāūṇaṁ parūvaṇā tassa kāyavvā // PiṇḍNi.3
---------------------------------------------------------------------
kulaē ya caubhāgassa sambhavō chakkaē cauṇhaṁ ca
niyamēṇa sambhavō atthi chakkagaṁ nikkhivē tamhā // PiṇḍNi.4
---------------------------------------------------------------------
nāmaṇṭhavaṇāpiṇḍō davvē khettē ya kāla bhāvē ya
ēsō khalu piṇḍassa u nikkhēvō chavvihō hōi // PiṇḍNi.5
---------------------------------------------------------------------
goṇṇaṁ samayakayaṁ vā jaṁ vāvi havejja tadubhaēṇa kayaṁ
taṁ binti nāmapiṇḍaṁ ṭhavaṇāpiṇḍaṁ aō vocchaṁ // PiṇḍNi.6
---------------------------------------------------------------------
guṇanipphannaṁ goṇṇaṁ taṁ cēva jahatthama satthavī benti
taṁ puṇa khavaṇō jalaṇō tavaṇō pavaṇō paīvō ya // PiṇḍNi.7
---------------------------------------------------------------------
piṇḍaṇa bahudavvāṇaṁ paḍivakkhēṇāvi jattha piṇḍakkhā
sō samayakaō piṇḍō jaha suttaṁ piṇḍapaḍiyāī // PiṇḍNi.8
---------------------------------------------------------------------
jassa puṇa piṇḍavāyaṭṭhayaṁ paviṭṭhassa hōi sampattī
guḍaōyaṇapiṇḍēhiṁ taṁ tadubhayapiṇḍamāhaṁsu // PiṇḍNi.9
---------------------------------------------------------------------
ubhayāirittamahavā annampi hu atthi lōiyaṁ nāma
attābhippāyakayaṁ jaha sīhagadēvadattāī // PiṇḍNi.10
---------------------------------------------------------------------
goṇṇasamayārittaṁ iṇamannaṁ vā'vi sūiyaṁ nāma
jaha piṇḍautti kīrai kassai nāmaṁ manūsassa // PiṇḍNi.11
---------------------------------------------------------------------
tullē'vi abhippāē samayapasiddhaṁ na giṇhaē lōō
jaṁ puṇa lōyapasiddhaṁ taṁ sāmaiyā uvacaranti // PiṇḍNi.12
---------------------------------------------------------------------
akkhē varāḍaē vā kaṭṭhē putthē va cittakammē vā
sabbhāvamasabbhāvē ṭhavaṇāpiṇḍaṁ viyāṇāhi // PiṇḍNi.13
---------------------------------------------------------------------
ikkō u asabbhāvē tiṇhaṁ ṭhavaṇā u hōi sabbhāvē
cittēsu asabbhāvē dārualeppōvalē siyarō // PiṇḍNi.14
---------------------------------------------------------------------
tivihō u davvapiṇḍō saccittō mīsaō acittō ya
ekkekkassa ya ettō nava nava bhēā u pattēyaṁ ।। gāhā-16 // PiṇḍNi.15
---------------------------------------------------------------------
puḍhavī āukkāō tēū vāū vaṇassaī cēva
bēindiya tēindiya caurō pañcendiyā cēva // PiṇḍNi.16
---------------------------------------------------------------------
puḍhavīkāō tivihō saccittō mīsaō ya accittō
saccittō puṇa duvihō nicchayavavahāraō cēva // PiṇḍNi.17
---------------------------------------------------------------------
nicchayaō saccittō puḍhavimahāpavvayāṇa bahumajjhē
accittamīsavajjō sēsō vavahārasaccittō // PiṇḍNi.18
---------------------------------------------------------------------
khīradumaheṭṭha panthē kaṭṭhōlē indhaṇē ya mīsō u
pōrisi ēga duga tigaṁ bahuindhaṇamajjhathōvē ya // PiṇḍNi.19
---------------------------------------------------------------------
sīuṇha-khāra-khattē aggī-lōṇūsa ambilē-nēhē
vukkantajōṇiēṇaṁ payōyaṇaṁ tēṇimaṁ hōi // PiṇḍNi.20
---------------------------------------------------------------------
avaraddhigavisabandhē lavaṇēṇa va surabhiuvalaēṇaṁ vā
accittassa u gahaṇaṁ paōyaṇaṁ tēṇimaṁ ca'nnaṁ // PiṇḍNi.21
---------------------------------------------------------------------
ṭhāṇanisiyaṇatuyaṭṭaṇa uccārāī cēva ussaggō
ghaṭṭagaḍagalagalēvō ēmāi paōyaṇaṁ bahuhā // PiṇḍNi.22
---------------------------------------------------------------------
āukkāō tivihō saccittō mīsaō ya accittō
saccittō puṇa duvihō nicchayavavahāraō cēva // PiṇḍNi.23
---------------------------------------------------------------------
ghanaudahī ghanavalayā karagasamuddaddahāṇa bahumajjhē
aha nicchayasaccittō vavahāranayassa aghaḍāī // PiṇḍNi.24
---------------------------------------------------------------------
usiṇōdagamanuvattē daṇḍē vāsē ya paḍiyamittammi
mottūṇādēsatigaṁ cāulaudagē'bahu pasannaṁ // PiṇḍNi.25
---------------------------------------------------------------------
bhaṇḍagapāsavilaggā uttēḍā bubbuyā na saṁmanti
jā tāva mīsagaṁ tandulā ya rajjhanti jāva'nnē // PiṇḍNi.26
---------------------------------------------------------------------
ēē u anāēsā tinni vi kālaniyamassa'sambhavaō
lukkhēyara bhaṇḍaga pavaṇa sambhavāsambhavāīhiṁ // PiṇḍNi.27
---------------------------------------------------------------------
jāva na bahuppasannaṁ tā mīsaṁ ēsa ittha āēsō
hōi pamāṇamacittaṁ bahuppasannaṁ tu nāyavvaṁ // PiṇḍNi.28
---------------------------------------------------------------------
sīuṇha khārakhattē aggī lōṇūsa ambilē nēhē
vukkantajōṇiēṇaṁ paōyaṇaṁ tēṇimaṁ hōi // PiṇḍNi.29
---------------------------------------------------------------------
parisēyapiyaṇahatthāi dhōvaṇaṁ cīradhōvaṇaṁ cēva
āyamaṇa bhāṇadhuvaṇaṁ ēmāi paōyaṇaṁ bahuhā // PiṇḍNi.30
---------------------------------------------------------------------
uubaddha dhuvaṇa bāusa bambhavināsō aṭhāṇaṭhavaṇaṁ ca
sampāimavāuvahō pāvaṇa bhūōvaghāō ya // PiṇḍNi.31
---------------------------------------------------------------------
aibhāra cuḍaṇa paṇaē sīyalapāuraṇa'jīra gēlaṇṇē
ōhāvaṇa kāyavahō vāsāsu adhōvaṇē dōsā ।। gāhā-33 // PiṇḍNi.32
---------------------------------------------------------------------
appattecciya vāsē savvaṁ uvahiṁ dhuvanti jayaṇāē
asaīē u davassa ya jahannaō pāyanijjōgō // PiṇḍNi.33
---------------------------------------------------------------------
āyariyagilāṇāṇa ya mailā mailā puṇō'vi dhōvanti
mā hu gurūṇa avaṇṇō lōgammi ajīraṇaṁ iyarē // PiṇḍNi.34
---------------------------------------------------------------------
pāyassa paḍōyārō dunisijja tipaṭṭa potti rayaharaṇaṁ
ēē u na vīsāmē jayaṇā saṅkāmaṇā dhuvaṇaṁ // PiṇḍNi.35
---------------------------------------------------------------------
pāyassa paḍōyārō pattagavajjō ya pāyanijjōgō
donni nisijjāō puṇa abbhintara bāhirā cēva // PiṇḍNi.36
---------------------------------------------------------------------
santhāruttaracōlagapaṭṭā tinni u havanti nāyavvā
muhapottiyatti pottī ēganisejjaṁ ca rayaharaṇaṁ // PiṇḍNi.37
---------------------------------------------------------------------
ēē u na vīsāmē paidinamuvaōgaō ya jayaṇāē
saṅkāmiūṇa dhōvanti vijja chappaiyā tattha vihiṇā u // PiṇḍNi.38
---------------------------------------------------------------------
jō puṇa vīsamijjai taṁ ēvaṁ vīyarāya-āṇāē
pattē dhōvaṇakālē uvahiṁ vīsāmaē sāhū // PiṇḍNi.39
---------------------------------------------------------------------
abbhintaraparibhōgaṁ uvariṁ pāuṇai nāidūrē ya
tinni ya tinni ya ēgaṁ nisiṁ tu kāuṁ paricchijjā // PiṇḍNi.40
---------------------------------------------------------------------
dhōvatthaṁ tinni dinā uvariṁ pāuṇai taha ya āsannaṁ
dhārēi tinni diyahē ēgadinaṁ uvari lambantaṁ // PiṇḍNi.41
---------------------------------------------------------------------
kēī ekkekkanisiṁ saṁvāsēuṁ tihā paricchanti
pāuṇai jai na lagganti chappaiyā tāhi dhōvanti // PiṇḍNi.42
---------------------------------------------------------------------
nivvōdagassa gahaṇaṁ kēī bhāṇēsu asui paḍisēhō
gihibhāyaṇēsu gahaṇaṁ ṭhiya vāsē mīsagaṁ chārō // PiṇḍNi.43
---------------------------------------------------------------------
gurupaccakkhāṇigilāṇa sēhamāīṇa dhōvaṇaṁ puvvaṁ
tō appaṇō puvvamahākaḍē ya iyarē duvē pacchā // PiṇḍNi.44
---------------------------------------------------------------------
acchōḍapiṭṭaṇāsu ya na dhuvē dhōē payāvaṇaṁ na karē
paribhōga aparibhōgē chāyāyava pēha kallāṇaṁ // PiṇḍNi.45
---------------------------------------------------------------------
tivihō tēukkāō saccittō mīsaō ya accittō
sacittō puṇa duvihō nicchaya vavahāraō cēva // PiṇḍNi.46
---------------------------------------------------------------------
iṭṭagapāgāīṇaṁ bahumajjhē vijjumāi nicchayaō
iṅgālāī iyarotti mummuramāī u missō u // PiṇḍNi.47
---------------------------------------------------------------------
ōyaṇavañjaṇapānaga āyāmusiṇōdagaṁ ca kummāsā
ḍagalagasarakkhasūī pippalamāī u uvaōgō // PiṇḍNi.48
---------------------------------------------------------------------
vāukkāō tivihō saccittō mīsaō ya accittō
sacittō puṇa duvihō nicchayavavahāraō cēva ।। gāhā-50 // PiṇḍNi.49
---------------------------------------------------------------------
savalaya ghanatanuvāyā aihima aiduddiṇē ya nicchayaō
vavahāra pāiṇāī akkantāī ya accittō // PiṇḍNi.50
---------------------------------------------------------------------
akkantadhantaghāṇē dēhānugaē ya pīliyāisu ya
accitta vāukāō va ēvavihō bhaṇiō kammaṭṭhamahaṇēhiṁ // PiṇḍNi.51
---------------------------------------------------------------------
hatthasayamēga gantā daiō accittu bīyaē mīsō
taiyammi u sacittō vatthī puṇa pōrisidinēsu // PiṇḍNi.52
---------------------------------------------------------------------
niddhēyarō ya kālō ēgantisiṇiddhamajjhimajahannō
lukkhōvi hōi tivihō jahannamajjhō ya ukkōsō // PiṇḍNi.53
---------------------------------------------------------------------
ēgantasiṇiddhaṁmī pōrisimēgaṁ acēaṇō hōi
biiyāē saṁmīsō taiyāi sacēyaṇō vatthī // PiṇḍNi.54
---------------------------------------------------------------------
majjhimaniddhē dō pōrisīu accittu mīsaō taiē
cautthīē saccittō pavaṇō daiyāi majjhagaō // PiṇḍNi.55
---------------------------------------------------------------------
pōrisitigamaccittō niddhajahannammi mīsaga cautthī
saccitta pañcamīē ēvaṁ lukkhē'vi dinavuḍḍhī // PiṇḍNi.56
---------------------------------------------------------------------
daiēṇa vatthiṇā vā paōyaṇaṁ hojja vāuṇā muṇiṇō
gēlannammi va hojjā sacittamīsē pariharejjā // PiṇḍNi.57
---------------------------------------------------------------------
vaṇasaikāō tivihō saccittō mīsaō ya accittō
saccittō puṇa duvihō nicchayavavahāraō cēva // PiṇḍNi.58
---------------------------------------------------------------------
savvō'va'nantakāō saccittō hōi nicchayanayassa
vavahārassa ya sēsō mīsō pavvāyaroṭṭāī // PiṇḍNi.59
---------------------------------------------------------------------
pupphāṇaṁ pattāṇaṁ saraḍuphalāṇaṁ tahēva hariyāṇaṁ
veṇṭammi milāṇammi nāyavvaṁ jīvavippajaḍhaṁ // PiṇḍNi.60
---------------------------------------------------------------------
santhārapāyadaṇḍagakhōmiya kappā ya pīḍhaphalagāī
ōsahabhēsajjāṇi ya ēmāi paōyaṇaṁ bahuhā // PiṇḍNi.61
---------------------------------------------------------------------
biyatiyacaurō pañcandiyā ya tippabhii jattha u samenti
saṭṭhāṇē saṭṭhāṇē sō piṇḍō tēṇa kajjamiṇaṁ // PiṇḍNi.62
---------------------------------------------------------------------
bēindiyaparibhōgō akkhāṇa sasippasaṅkhamāīṇaṁ
tēindiyāṇa uddēhigādi jaṁ vā vaē vejjō // PiṇḍNi.63
---------------------------------------------------------------------
caurindiyāṇa macchiyaparihārō cēva āsamakkhiyā cēva
pañcendiyapiṇḍammi u avvavahārī u nēraiyā // PiṇḍNi.64
---------------------------------------------------------------------
cammaṭṭhidantanaharōmasiṅga avilāichagaṇagōmuttē
khīradadhimāiyāṇa ya pañcindiyatiriyaparibhōgō // PiṇḍNi.65
---------------------------------------------------------------------
saccittē pavvāvaṇa panthuvaēsē ya bhikkhadāṇāī
sīsaṭṭhiga accittē mīsaṭṭhisarakkhapahapucchā ।। gāhā-67 // PiṇḍNi.66
---------------------------------------------------------------------
khamagāi kālakajjāiēsu pucchijja dēvayaṁ kañci
panthē subhāsubhē vā pucchēī divva uvaōgō // PiṇḍNi.67
---------------------------------------------------------------------
aha mīsaō ya piṇḍō ēēsiṁ ciya navaṇha piṇḍāṇaṁ
duga sañjōgāīō nāyavvō jāva caramotti // PiṇḍNi.68
---------------------------------------------------------------------
sōvīra gōrasāsava vēsaṇa bhēsajja nēha sāgaphalē
poggalalōṇa gulōyaṇa nēgā piṇḍā u sañjōgē // PiṇḍNi.69
---------------------------------------------------------------------
tinni u paēsasamayā ṭhāṇaṭṭhiiu daviē tayāēsā
caupañcamapiṇḍāṇaṁ jattha jayā tapparūvaṇayā // PiṇḍNi.70
---------------------------------------------------------------------
muttadaviēsu jujjai jai annonnāṇuvēhaō piṇḍō
muttivimuttēsuvi sō jujjai nanusaṅkhabāhullā // PiṇḍNi.71
---------------------------------------------------------------------
jaha tipaēsō khandhō tisuvi paēsēsu jō samōgāḍhō
avibhāgiṇa sambaddhō kahannu nēvaṁ tadādhārō? // PiṇḍNi.72
---------------------------------------------------------------------
ahavā cauṇha niyamā jōgavibhāgēṇa jujjaē piṇḍō
dōsu jahiyaṁ tu piṇḍō vaṇṇijjai kīraē vāvi // PiṇḍNi.73
---------------------------------------------------------------------
duvihō u bhāvapiṇḍō pasatthaō cēva appasatthō ya
ēēsiṁ dōṇhampiya pattēya parūvaṇaṁ vocchaṁ // PiṇḍNi.74
---------------------------------------------------------------------
ēgavihāidasavihō pasatthaō cēva appasatthō ya
sañjama vijjācaraṇē nāṇāditigaṁ ca tivihō u // PiṇḍNi.75
---------------------------------------------------------------------
nāṇaṁ daṁsaṇaṁ tava sañjamō ya vaya pañca chacca jāṇejjā
piṇḍēsaṇaṁ pāṇēsaṇaṁ uggahapaḍimā ya piṇḍammi // PiṇḍNi.76
---------------------------------------------------------------------
pavayaṇamāyā nava bambhaguttiō taha ya samaṇadhammō ya
ēsa pasatthō piṇḍō bhaṇiō kammaṭṭhamahaṇēhiṁ // PiṇḍNi.77
---------------------------------------------------------------------
apasatthō ya asañjama annāṇaṁ avirai ya micchattaṁ
kōhāyāsavakāyā kammē'guttī a hammō ya // PiṇḍNi.78
---------------------------------------------------------------------
bajjhai ya jēṇa kammaṁ sō savvō hōi appasatthō u
muccai ya jēṇa sō uṇa pasatthaō navari vinnēō // PiṇḍNi.79
---------------------------------------------------------------------
daṁsaṇanāṇacarittāṇa pajjavā jē u jattiyā vā'vi
sō sō hōi tayakkhō pajjavapēyālaṇā piṇḍō // PiṇḍNi.80
---------------------------------------------------------------------
kammāṇa jēṇa bhāvēṇa appagaṁ ciṇai cikkaṇaṁ piṇḍaṁ
sō hōi bhāvapiṇḍō piṇḍayaē piṇḍaṇa jamhā // PiṇḍNi.81
---------------------------------------------------------------------
davvē accittēṇaṁ bhāvammi vēya pasatthaēṇihaṁ pagayaṁ
uccāriyatthasarisā sīsamai vikōvaṇaṭṭhāē // PiṇḍNi.82
---------------------------------------------------------------------
āhārauvahisejjā pasatthapiṇḍassuvaggahaṁ kuṇai
āhārē ahigārō aṭṭhahiṁ ṭhāṇēhiṁ sō suddhō ।। gāhā-84 // PiṇḍNi.83
---------------------------------------------------------------------
nivvāṇaṁ khalu kajjaṁ nāṇāitigaṁ ca kāraṇaṁ tassa
nivvāṇakāraṇāṇaṁ ca kāraṇaṁ hōi āhārō // PiṇḍNi.84
---------------------------------------------------------------------
jaha kāraṇaṁ tu tantū paḍassa tēsiṁ ca honti pamhāiṁ
nāṇāitigassēvaṁ āhārō mokkhanēmassa // PiṇḍNi.85
---------------------------------------------------------------------
jaha kāraṇamanuvahayaṁ kajjaṁ sāhēi avikalaṁ niyamā
mokkhakkhamāṇi ēvaṁ nāṇāīṇi u avigalāiṁ // PiṇḍNi.86
---------------------------------------------------------------------
saṅkhēvapiṇḍiyatthō ēvaṁ piṇḍō maē samakkhāō
phuḍaviyaḍapāyaḍatthaṁ vocchāmi ēsaṇaṁ ettō // PiṇḍNi.87
---------------------------------------------------------------------
ēsaṇa gavēsaṇa maggaṇā ya uggōvaṇā ya boddhavvā
ēē u ēsaṇāē nāmā ēgaṭṭhiyā honti // PiṇḍNi.88
---------------------------------------------------------------------
nāmaṇṭhavaṇā daviē bhāvammi ya ēsaṇā muṇēyavvā
davvē bhāvē ekkekkayā u tivihā muṇēyavvā // PiṇḍNi.89
---------------------------------------------------------------------
jammaṁ ēsai ēgō suyassa annō tamēsaē naṭṭhaṁ
sattuṁ ēsai annō paēṇa annō ya sē maccuṁ // PiṇḍNi.90
---------------------------------------------------------------------
ēmēva sēsaēsu vi cauppayāpaya acittamīsēsu
jā jattha jujjaē ēsaṇā u taṁ tattha jōejjā // PiṇḍNi.91
---------------------------------------------------------------------
bhāvēsaṇā u tivihā gavēsagahaṇēsaṇā u boddhavvā
gāsēsaṇā u kamasō pannattā vīyarāgēhiṁ // PiṇḍNi.92
---------------------------------------------------------------------
agaviṭṭhassa u gahaṇaṁ na hōi na ya agahiyassa paribhōgō
ēsaṇatigassa ēsā nāyavvā ānupuvvī u // PiṇḍNi.93
---------------------------------------------------------------------
nāmaṁ ṭhavaṇā daviē bhāvammi gavēsaṇā muṇēyavvā
davvammi kuraṅgagayā uggamauppāyaṇā bhāvē // PiṇḍNi.94
---------------------------------------------------------------------
jiyasattudēvicitta sabhapavisaṇaṁ kanagapiṭṭhapāsaṇayā
dōhaladubbalapucchā kahaṇaṁ āṇā ya purisāṇaṁ // PiṇḍNi.95
---------------------------------------------------------------------
sīvannisarisamōyagakaraṇaṁ sīvannirukkhaheṭṭhēsu
āgamana kuraṅgāṇaṁ pasattha apasattha uvamā u // PiṇḍNi.96
---------------------------------------------------------------------
viiamēyaṁ kuraṅgāṇaṁ jayā sīvanni sīyai
purāvi vāyā vāyantā na uṇaṁ puñjakapuñjakā // PiṇḍNi.97
---------------------------------------------------------------------
hatthiggahaṇaṁ gimhē arahaṭṭēhiṁ bharaṇaṁ ca sarasīṇaṁ
accudaēṇa nalavaṇā ahirūḍhā gayakulāgamanaṁ // PiṇḍNi.98
---------------------------------------------------------------------
viiyamēyaṁ gajakulāṇaṁ jayā rōhanti nalavaṇā
annayāvi jharanti jharā na ya ēvaṁ bahuōdagā // PiṇḍNi.99
---------------------------------------------------------------------
uggama uggōvaṇa maggaṇā ya ēgaṭṭhiyāi ēyāṇi
nāmaṁ ṭhavaṇā daviē bhāvammi ya uggahō hōi ।। gāhā-101 // PiṇḍNi.100
---------------------------------------------------------------------
davvammi laḍḍugāī bhāvē tivihoggamō muṇēyavvō
daṁsaṇanāṇacarittē cariuggamēṇettha ahigārō // PiṇḍNi.101
---------------------------------------------------------------------
jōisataṇōsahīṇaṁ mēhariṇakarāṇamuggamō davvē
sō puṇa jattō ya jayā jahā ya davvuggamō vaccō // PiṇḍNi.102
---------------------------------------------------------------------
vāsaharā anujattā atthāṇī jogga kiḍḍakālē ya
ghaḍagasarāvēsu kayā u mōgayā laḍḍugapiyassa // PiṇḍNi.103
---------------------------------------------------------------------
jogga ajiṇṇa māruya nisagga tisamuttha tō suisamutthō
āhāruggamacintā asuitti duhā malappabhavō // PiṇḍNi.104
---------------------------------------------------------------------
tassēvaṁ vēragguggamēṇa sammattanāṇacaraṇāṇaṁ
jugavaṁ kamuggamō vā kēvalanāṇuggamō jāō // PiṇḍNi.105
---------------------------------------------------------------------
daṁsaṇanāṇappabhavaṁ caraṇaṁ suddhēsu tēsu tassuddhī
caraṇēṇa kammasuddhī uggamasamuddhīi caraṇasuddhī // PiṇḍNi.106
---------------------------------------------------------------------
āhākammuddēsiya pūīkammē ya mīsajāē ya
ṭhavaṇā pāhuḍiyāē pāōara kīya pāmiccē // PiṇḍNi.107
---------------------------------------------------------------------
pariyaṭṭiē abhihaḍē ubbhinnē mālōhaḍē iya
acchijjē anisiṭṭhē ajjhōyaraē ya sōlasamē // PiṇḍNi.108
---------------------------------------------------------------------
āhākammiyanāmā ēgaṭṭhā kassa vāvi kiṁ vāvi ?
parapakkhē ya sapakkhē caurō gahaṇē ya āṇāī // PiṇḍNi.109
---------------------------------------------------------------------
āhā ahē ya kammē āyāhammē ya attakammē ya
paḍisēvaṇa paḍisuṇaṇā saṁvāsa'numōyaṇā cēva // PiṇḍNi.110
---------------------------------------------------------------------
dhanujuyakāyabharāṇaṁ kuḍumba-rajjadhuramāiyāṇaṁ ca
khandhāī hiyayaṁ miya davvāhā antaē dhaṇuṇō // PiṇḍNi.111
---------------------------------------------------------------------
ōrālasarīrāṇaṁ uddavaṇa tivāyaṇaṁ ca jassaṭṭhā
maṇamāhittā kīrai āhākammaṁ tayaṁ benti // PiṇḍNi.112
---------------------------------------------------------------------
ōrālaggahaṇēṇaṁ tirikkhamanuyā'havā suhumavajjā
uddavaṇaṁ puṇa jāṇasu aivāyavivajjiyaṁ pīḍaṁ // PiṇḍNi.113
---------------------------------------------------------------------
kāyavaimanō tinni u ahavā dēhāuindiyappāṇā
sāmittāvāyāṇē hōi tivāō ya karaṇēsu ya // PiṇḍNi.114
---------------------------------------------------------------------
hiyayammi samāhēuṁ ēgamanēgaṁ ca gāhagaṁ jō u
vahanaṁ karēi dāyā kāyēṇa tamāhakammaṁ ti // PiṇḍNi.115
---------------------------------------------------------------------
jaṁ davvaṁ udagāisu chūḍhamahē vayai jaṁ ca bhārēṇaṁ
sīīē rajjuēṇa va ōyaraṇaṁ davva'hēkammaṁ // PiṇḍNi.116
---------------------------------------------------------------------
sañjamaṭhāṇāṇaṁ kaṇḍagāṇa lēsā-ṭhiī-visēsāṇaṁ
bhāvaṁ ahē karēī tamhā taṁ bhāva'hēkammaṁ ।। gāhā-118 // PiṇḍNi.117
---------------------------------------------------------------------
tatthānantā u carittapajjavā honti sañjamaṭṭhāṇaṁ
saṅkhaiyāṇi u tāṇi kaṇḍagaṁ hōi nāyavvaṁ // PiṇḍNi.118
---------------------------------------------------------------------
saṅkhāīyāṇi u kaṇḍagāṇi chaṭṭhāṇagaṁ viniddiṭṭhaṁ
chaṭṭhāṇā u asaṅkhā sañjamasēḍhī muṇēyavvā // PiṇḍNi.119
---------------------------------------------------------------------
kiṇhāiyā u lēsā ukkōsavisuddhiṭhiivisēsāō
ēēsi visuddhāṇaṁ appaṁ taggāhagō kuṇai // PiṇḍNi.120
---------------------------------------------------------------------
bhāvōvayāramāhēumappagē kiñcinūṇa caraṇaggō
āhākammaggāhī ahō ahō nēi appāṇaṁ // PiṇḍNi.121
---------------------------------------------------------------------
bandhai ahē bhavāū pakarēi ahōmuhāiṁ kammāiṁ
ghanakaraṇaṁ tivvēṇa u bhāvēṇa caō uvacaō ya // PiṇḍNi.122
---------------------------------------------------------------------
tēsi gurūṇamudaēṇa appagaṁ duggaīē pavaḍantaṁ
na caēi vidhārēuṁ aharagatiṁ ninti kammāiṁ // PiṇḍNi.123
---------------------------------------------------------------------
aṭṭhāē aṇaṭṭhāē chakkāyapamaddaṇaṁ tu jō kuṇai
aniyāē ya niyāē āyāhammaṁ tayaṁ benti // PiṇḍNi.124
---------------------------------------------------------------------
jāṇantu ajāṇantō tahēva niddisiya ōhaō vā'vi
jāṇagamajāṇagē vā vahēi aniyā niyā ēsā // PiṇḍNi.125
---------------------------------------------------------------------
davvāyā khalu kāyā bhāvāyā tinni nāṇamāīṇi
parapāṇapāḍaṇaraō caraṇāyaṁ appaṇō haṇai // PiṇḍNi.126
---------------------------------------------------------------------
nicchayanayassa caraṇāya vidhāē nāṇadaṁsaṇavahō'vi
vavahārassa u caraṇē hayammi bhayaṇā u sēsāṇaṁ // PiṇḍNi.127
---------------------------------------------------------------------
davvammi attakammaṁ jaṁ jō u mamāyaē tagaṁ davvaṁ
bhāvē asuhapariṇaō parakammaṁ attaṇō kuṇai // PiṇḍNi.128
---------------------------------------------------------------------
āhākammapariṇaō phāsuyamavi saṅkiliṭṭhapariṇāmō
āiyamāṇō bajjhai taṁ jāṇasu attakammanti // PiṇḍNi.129
---------------------------------------------------------------------
parakamma attakammīkarēi taṁ jō u giṇhiuṁ bhuñjē
tattha bhavē parakiriyā kahaṁ nu annatthaṁ saṅkamaī? // PiṇḍNi.130
---------------------------------------------------------------------
kūḍauvamāi kēī parappauttē'vi bentiṁ bandhotti
bhaṇai gurūvi pamattō bajjhai kūḍē adakkhō ya // PiṇḍNi.131
---------------------------------------------------------------------
ēmēva bhāvakūḍē bajjhai jō asubhabhāvapariṇāmō
tamhā u asubhabhāvō vajjēyavvō payattēṇaṁ // PiṇḍNi.132
---------------------------------------------------------------------
kāmaṁ sayaṁ na kuvvai jāṇantō puṇa tahāvi taggāhī
vaḍḍhēi tappasaṅgaṁ agiṇhamāṇō u vārēi // PiṇḍNi.133
---------------------------------------------------------------------
attīkarēi kammaṁ paḍisēvāīhiṁ taṁ puṇa imēhiṁ
tattha gurū āipayaṁ lahu lahu lahugā kamēṇiyarē ।। gāhā-135 // PiṇḍNi.134
---------------------------------------------------------------------
paḍisēvaṇamāīṇaṁ dārāṇa'numōyaṇā-vasāṇāṇaṁ
jahasambhavaṁ sarūvaṁ sōdāharaṇaṁ pavakkhāmi // PiṇḍNi.135
---------------------------------------------------------------------
annēṇāhākammaṁ uvanīyaṁ asai cōiō bhaṇai
parahatthēṇaṅgārē kaḍḍhantō jaha na ḍajjhai hu // PiṇḍNi.136
---------------------------------------------------------------------
ēvaṁ khu suddhō dōsō dentassa kūḍauvamāē
samayatthamajāṇantō mūḍhō paḍisēvaṇaṁ kuṇai // PiṇḍNi.137
---------------------------------------------------------------------
uvaōgammi ya lābhaṁ kammaggāhissa cittarakkhaṭṭhā
ālōiē suladdhaṁ bhaṇai bhaṇantassa paḍisuṇaṇā // PiṇḍNi.138
---------------------------------------------------------------------
saṁvāsō u pasiddhō anumōyaṇa kammabhōyagapasaṁsā
ēēsimudāharaṇā ēē u kamēṇa nāyavvā // PiṇḍNi.139
---------------------------------------------------------------------
paḍisēvaṇāē tēṇā paḍisuṇaṇāē u rāyaputtō u
saṁvāsammi ya pallī anumōyaṇa rāyaduṭṭhō ya // PiṇḍNi.140
---------------------------------------------------------------------
gōṇīharaṇa sabhūmī nēūṇaṁ gōṇiō pahē bhakkhē
nivvisayā parivēsaṇa ṭhiyāvi tē kūviyā ghatthē // PiṇḍNi.141
---------------------------------------------------------------------
jē'viya parivēsantī bhāyaṇāṇi dharanti ya
tē'vi bajjhanti tivvēṇakammuṇā kimu bhōiṇō? // PiṇḍNi.142
---------------------------------------------------------------------
sāmatthaṇa rāyasuē piivahaṇa sahāya taha ya tuṇhikkō
tiṇhampi hu paḍisuṇaṇā raṇṇā siṭṭhammi sā natthi // PiṇḍNi.143
---------------------------------------------------------------------
bhuñja na bhuñjē bhuñjasu taiō tusiṇīu bhuñjaē paḍhamō
tiṇhampi hu paḍisuṇaṇā paḍisēhantassa sā natthi // PiṇḍNi.144
---------------------------------------------------------------------
āṇettubhuñjagā kammuṇā u bīyassa vāiō dōsō
taiyassa ya mānasiō tīhiṁ visuddhō cautthō u // PiṇḍNi.145
---------------------------------------------------------------------
paḍisēvaṇa paḍisuṇaṇā saṁvāsa'numōyaṇā u caurō vi
piyamāragarāyasuē vibhāsiyavvā jaijaṇē'vi // PiṇḍNi.146
---------------------------------------------------------------------
pallīvahammi naṭṭhā cōrā vaṇiyā vayaṁ na cōratti
na palāṇā pāvakara tti kāuṁ rannā uvāladdhā // PiṇḍNi.147
---------------------------------------------------------------------
āhākaḍabhōīhiṁ sahavāsō taha ya tavvivajjampi
daṁsaṇagandha parikahā bhāvinti sulūhavittimpi // PiṇḍNi.148
---------------------------------------------------------------------
rāyōrōha'varāhē vibhūsiō ghāiō nayaramajjhē
dhannādhannatti kahā vahāvahō kappaḍiyakhōlā // PiṇḍNi.149
---------------------------------------------------------------------
sāuṁ pajjattaṁ āyarēṇa kālē riukkhamaṁ niddhaṁ
tagguṇavikatthaṇāē abhuñjamāṇē'vi aṇumannā // PiṇḍNi.150
---------------------------------------------------------------------
āhā ahē ya kammē āyāhammē ya attakammē ya
jaha vañjaṇanāṇattaṁ atthēṇa'vi pucchaē ēvaṁ ।। gāhā-152 // PiṇḍNi.151
---------------------------------------------------------------------
ēgaṭṭhā ēgavañjaṇa ēgaṭṭhā nāṇavañjaṇā cēva
nāṇaṭṭha ēgavañjaṇa nāṇaṭṭhā vañjaṇānāṇā // PiṇḍNi.152
---------------------------------------------------------------------
diṭṭhaṁ khīraṁ khīraṁ ēgaṭṭhaṁ ēgavañjaṇaṁ lōē
ēgaṭṭhaṁ bahunāmaṁ duddha paō pīlu khīraṁ ca // PiṇḍNi.153
---------------------------------------------------------------------
gōmahisiayākhīraṁ nāṇaṭṭhaṁ ēgavañjaṇaṁ lōē
ghaḍapaḍasagaḍarahāī hōi pihatthaṁ pihaṁnāmaṁ // PiṇḍNi.154
---------------------------------------------------------------------
āhākammāīṇaṁ hōi duruttāiṁ paḍhamabhaṅgō u
āhāhēkammanti ya biiō sakkinda iva bhaṅgō // PiṇḍNi.155
---------------------------------------------------------------------
āhākammantariyā asaṇāīṁ u caurō taiyabhaṅgō
āhākamma paḍuccā niyamā sunnō carimabhaṅgō // PiṇḍNi.156
---------------------------------------------------------------------
indatthaṁ jaha saddā purandarāī u nāivattantē
ahakamma āyahammā taha āhaṁ nāivattantē // PiṇḍNi.157
---------------------------------------------------------------------
āhākammēṇa ahē karēti jaṁ haṇai pāṇabhūyāiṁ
jaṁ taṁ āiyamāṇō parakammaṁ attaṇō kuṇai // PiṇḍNi.158
---------------------------------------------------------------------
kassatti pucchiyaṁmī niyamā sāhammiyassa taṁ hōi
sāhammiyassa tamhā kāyavva parūvaṇā vihiṇā // PiṇḍNi.159
---------------------------------------------------------------------
nāmaṁ ṭhavaṇā daviē khettē kālē ya pavayaṇē liṅgē
daṁsaṇa nāṇa carittē abhiggahē bhāvaṇāō ya // PiṇḍNi.160
---------------------------------------------------------------------
nāmammi sarisanāmō ṭhavaṇāē kaṭṭhakammamāīyā
davvammi jō u bhaviō sāhammisarīragaṁ jaṁ ca // PiṇḍNi.161
---------------------------------------------------------------------
khettē samāṇadēvī kālammi samāṇa kālasambhūō
pavayaṇi saṅghēgayarō liṅgē rayaharaṇa muhapottī // PiṇḍNi.162
---------------------------------------------------------------------
daṁsaṇa nāṇē caraṇē tiga paṇa paṇa tiviha hōi u carittē
davvāiō abhiggaha aha bhāvaṇamō aniccāī // PiṇḍNi.163
---------------------------------------------------------------------
jāvanta dēvadattā gihī va agihīva tēsi dāhāmi
nō kappaī gihīṇaṁ dāhanti visēsiyaṁ kappē // PiṇḍNi.164
---------------------------------------------------------------------
pāsaṇḍīsu na vi ēvaṁ mīsāmīsēsu hōi hu vibhāsā
samaṇēsu sañjayāṇa u visarisanāmāṇavi na kappē // PiṇḍNi.165
---------------------------------------------------------------------
nīsamanīsā va kaḍaṁ ṭhavaṇāsāhammiyammi u vibhāsā
davvē mayataṇubhattaṁ na taṁ tu kucchā vivajjejjā // PiṇḍNi.166
---------------------------------------------------------------------
pāsaṇḍiyasamaṇāṇaṁ gihinigganthāṇaṁ cēva u vibhāsā
jaha nāmammi tahēva ya khettē kālē ya nāyavvaṁ // PiṇḍNi.167
---------------------------------------------------------------------
dasa sasihāgā sāvaga pavayaṇasāhammiyā na liṅgēṇa
liṅgēṇa u sāhammī nō pavayaṇa niṇhagā savvē ।। gāhā-169 // PiṇḍNi.168
---------------------------------------------------------------------
visarisadaṁsaṇajuttā pavayaṇasāhammiyā na daṁsaṇaō
titthagarā pattēyā nō pavayaṇadaṁsa sāhammī // PiṇḍNi.169
---------------------------------------------------------------------
nāṇacarittā ēvaṁ nāyavvā honti pavayaṇēṇaṁ tu
pavayaṇaō sāhammī nābhiggahasāvagā jaiṇō // PiṇḍNi.170
---------------------------------------------------------------------
sāhamma'bhiggahēṇaṁ nō pavayaṇa niṇha tittha pattēyā
ēvaṁ pavayaṇabhāvaṇa ettō sēsāṇa vocchāmi // PiṇḍNi.171
---------------------------------------------------------------------
liṅgāīhivi ēvaṁ ekkekkēṇaṁ tu uvarimā nēyā
jē'nannē uvarillā tē mottuṁ sēsaē ēvaṁ // PiṇḍNi.172
---------------------------------------------------------------------
liṅgēṇa u sāhammī na daṁsaṇē vīsudaṁsi jainiṇhā
pattēyabuddha titthaṅkarā ya bīyammi bhaṅgammi // PiṇḍNi.173
---------------------------------------------------------------------
liṅgēṇa u nābhiggaha aṇabhiggaha vīsu'bhiggahā cēva
jaisāvaga biyabhaṅgē pattēyabuhā ya titthayarā // PiṇḍNi.174
---------------------------------------------------------------------
ēvaṁ liṅgēṇa bhāvaṇa daṁsaṇanāṇē ya paḍhamabhaṅgō u
jaisāvaga visunāṇī ēvaṁ ciya biiyabhaṅgō'vi // PiṇḍNi.175
---------------------------------------------------------------------
daṁsaṇacaraṇē paḍhamō sāvaga jaiṇō ya bīyabhaṅgō u
jaiṇō visarisadaṁsī daṁsē ya abhiggahē vocchaṁ // PiṇḍNi.176
---------------------------------------------------------------------
sāvaga jai vīsa'bhiggaha paḍhamō bīō ya bhāvanā cēvaṁ
nāṇēṇa'vi nejjēvaṁ ettō caraṇēṇa vocchāmi // PiṇḍNi.177
---------------------------------------------------------------------
jaiṇō vīsābhiggaha paḍhamō biya niṇhasāvagajaiṇō u
ēvaṁ tu bhāvaṇāsu'vi vocchaṁ dōṇhantimāṇittō // PiṇḍNi.178
---------------------------------------------------------------------
jaiṇō sāvaga niṇhava paḍhamē biiē ya hunti bhaṅgē ya
kēvalanāṇē titthaṅkarassa nō kappai kayaṁ tu // PiṇḍNi.179
---------------------------------------------------------------------
pattēyabuddha niṇhava uvāsaē kēvalī vi āsajja
khaiyāiē ya bhāvē paḍucca bhaṅgē u jōejjā // PiṇḍNi.180
---------------------------------------------------------------------
jattha u taiō bhaṅgō tattha na kappaṁ tu sēsaē bhayaṇā
titthaṅkarakēvaliṇō jaha kappaṁ nō ya sēsāṇaṁ // PiṇḍNi.181
---------------------------------------------------------------------
kiṁ taṁ āhākammanti pucchiē tassarūvakahaṇatthaṁ
sambhavapadarisaṇatthaṁ ca tassa asaṇāiyaṁ bhaṇai // PiṇḍNi.182
---------------------------------------------------------------------
sālīmāī avaḍē phalē ya suṇṭhāi sāimaṁ hōi
tassa kaḍaniṭṭhiyaṁmī suddhamasuddhē ya cattāri // PiṇḍNi.183
---------------------------------------------------------------------
koddavarālagagāmē vasahī ramaṇijja bhikkha sajjhāē
khettapaḍilēhasañjaya sāvayapucchujjuē kahaṇā // PiṇḍNi.184
---------------------------------------------------------------------
jujjai gaṇassa khettaṁ navari gurūṇaṁ tu natthi pāuggaṁ
sālitti kaē rumpaṇa paribhāyaṇa niyayagēhēsu ।। gāhā-186 // PiṇḍNi.185
---------------------------------------------------------------------
vōlintā tē va annē vā aḍantā tattha gōyaraṁ
suṇanti ēsaṇājuttā bālādijanasaṅkahā // PiṇḍNi.186
---------------------------------------------------------------------
ēē tē jēsimō raddhō sālikūrō gharē gharē
dinnō vā sēsayaṁ dēmi dēhi vā binti vā imaṁ // PiṇḍNi.187
---------------------------------------------------------------------
thakkē thakkāvaḍiyaṁ abhattaē sālibhattayaṁ jāyaṁ
majjha ya paissa maraṇaṁ diyarassa ya sē mayā bhajjā // PiṇḍNi.188
---------------------------------------------------------------------
cāulōdagampi sē dēhi sālīāyāmakañjiyaṁ
kimēyanti kayaṁ nāuṁ ? vajjanta'nnaṁ vayanti ya // PiṇḍNi.189
---------------------------------------------------------------------
lōṇāgaḍōdaē ēvaṁ khāṇittu mahurōdagaṁ
ḍhakkiēṇa'cchatē tāva jāva sāhutti āgayā // PiṇḍNi.190
---------------------------------------------------------------------
kakkaḍiya ambagā vā dāḍima dakkhā ya bīyapūrāī
khāima'higaraṇakaraṇanti sāimaṁ tigaḍugāīyaṁ // PiṇḍNi.191
---------------------------------------------------------------------
asaṇāīṇa cauṇhavi āmaṁ jaṁ sāhugahaṇapāuggaṁ
taṁ niṭṭhiyaṁ viyāṇasu uvakkhaḍaṁ tū kaḍaṁ hōi // PiṇḍNi.192
---------------------------------------------------------------------
kaṇḍiyatiguṇukkaṇḍā u niṭṭhiyā nēgaduguṇakaṇḍā u
niṭṭhiyakaḍō u kūrō āhākammaṁ duguṇamāhu // PiṇḍNi.193
---------------------------------------------------------------------
chāyampi vivajjantī kēī phalahēugāivuttassa
taṁ tu na jujjai jamhā phalampi kappaṁ biiyabhaṅgē // PiṇḍNi.194
---------------------------------------------------------------------
parapaccaiyā chāyā navi sā rukkhovvaṁ vaṭṭiyā kattā
naṭṭhacchāē u dumē kappai ēvaṁ bhaṇantassa // PiṇḍNi.195
---------------------------------------------------------------------
vaḍḍhai hāyai chāyā tacchikkaṁ pūiyampiva na kappē
na ya āhāya suvihiē nivvattayaī ravicchāyaṁ // PiṇḍNi.196
---------------------------------------------------------------------
aghanaghanacārigagaṇē chāyā naṭṭhā diyā puṇō hōi
kappai nirāyavē nāma āyavē taṁ vivajjēuṁ // PiṇḍNi.197
---------------------------------------------------------------------
tamhā na ēsa dōsō sambhavaī kammalakkhaṇavihūṇō
tampiya hu aighillā vajjēmāṇā adōsillā // PiṇḍNi.198
---------------------------------------------------------------------
parapakkhō u gihatthā samaṇā samaṇīu hōi u sapakkhō
phāsukaḍaṁ raddhaṁ vā niṭṭhiyamiyaraṁ kaḍaṁ savvaṁ // PiṇḍNi.199
---------------------------------------------------------------------
tassa kaḍaniṭṭhiyaṁmī annassa kaḍammi niṭṭhiē tassa
caubhaṅgō ittha bhavē caramadugē hōi kappaṁ tu // PiṇḍNi.200
---------------------------------------------------------------------
caurō aikkama vaikkamō ya aiyāra taha anāyārō
niddarisaṇa cauṇhavi āhākammē nimantaṇayā // PiṇḍNi.201
---------------------------------------------------------------------
sālīghayagulagōrasa navēsu vallīphalēsu jāēsuṁ
dānē ahigamasaḍḍhē āhāya kaē nimantēi ।। gāhā-203 // PiṇḍNi.202
---------------------------------------------------------------------
āhākammaggahaṇē aikammāīsu vaṭṭaē causu
nēurahāriga hatthī cautiga dugaēga calaṇēṇaṁ // PiṇḍNi.203
---------------------------------------------------------------------
āhākammāmantaṇa paḍisuṇamāṇē aikkamō hōi
payabhēyāu vaikkama gahiē taiēyarō giliē // PiṇḍNi.204
---------------------------------------------------------------------
āṇāiṇō ya dōsā gahaṇē jaṁ bhaṇiyamaha imē tē u
āṇābhaṅga'ṇavatthā micchatta virāhaṇā cēva // PiṇḍNi.205
---------------------------------------------------------------------
āṇaṁ savvajiṇāṇaṁ giṇhantō taṁ aikkamai luddhō
āṇaṁ ca'ikkamantō kassāēsā kuṇai sēsaṁ ? // PiṇḍNi.206
---------------------------------------------------------------------
ekkēṇa kayamakajjaṁ karēi tappaccayā puṇō annō
sāyābahula parampara vocchēō sañjamatavāṇaṁ // PiṇḍNi.207
---------------------------------------------------------------------
jō jahavāyaṁ na kuṇaī micchaddiṭṭhī taō hu kō annō ?
vaḍḍhēi ya micchattaṁ parassa saṅkaṁ jaṇēmāṇō // PiṇḍNi.208
---------------------------------------------------------------------
vaḍḍhēi tappasaṅgaṁ gēhī ya parassa appaṇō cēva
sajiyampi bhinnadāḍhō na muyai niddhandhasō pacchā // PiṇḍNi.209
---------------------------------------------------------------------
khaddhē niddhē ya ruyā suttē hānī tigicchaṇē kāyā
paḍiyaragāṇavi hānī kuṇai kilēsaṁ kilissantō // PiṇḍNi.210
---------------------------------------------------------------------
jaha kammaṁ tu akappaṁ tacchikkaṁ vā'vi bhāyaṇaṭhiyaṁ vā

avvattamattasaḍḍhē avimbhalē vā asāgariē // PiṇḍNi.640
---------------------------------------------------------------------
suimbhaddagadittāī daḍhaggahē vēviē jarammi sivē
annadhariyaṁ tu saḍḍhō dēyandhō'nnēṇa vā dhariē // PiṇḍNi.641
---------------------------------------------------------------------
maṇḍalapasūtikuṭṭhī'sāgariē pāuyāgaē ayalē
kamabaddhē saviyārē iyarē biṭṭhē asāgariē // PiṇḍNi.642
---------------------------------------------------------------------
paṇḍaga appaḍisēvī vēlā thaṇajīvi iyara savvampi
ukkhittamanāvāē na kiñci laggaṁ ṭhavantīē // PiṇḍNi.643
---------------------------------------------------------------------
pīsantī nippiṭṭhē phāsuṁ vā dhusulaṇē asaṁsattaṁ
kattaṇi asaṅkhacuṇṇaṁ cuṇṇaṁ vā jā acokkhaliṇī ।। gāhā-645 // PiṇḍNi.644
---------------------------------------------------------------------
uvvaṭṭaṇi'saṁsattēṇa vā'vi aṭṭīllaē na ghaṭṭēi
piñjaṇapamaddaṇēsu ya pacchākammaṁ jahiṁ natthi // PiṇḍNi.645
---------------------------------------------------------------------
sēsēsu ya paḍivakkhō na sambhavai kāyagahaṇamāīsu
paḍivakkhassa abhāvē niyamā u bhavē tayaggahaṇaṁ // PiṇḍNi.646
---------------------------------------------------------------------
saccittē accittē mīsaga ummīsagammi caubhaṅgō
āitiē paḍisēhō carimē bhaṅgammi bhayaṇā u // PiṇḍNi.647
---------------------------------------------------------------------
jaha cēva ya sañjōgā kāyāṇaṁ heṭṭhaō ya sāharaṇē
taha cēva ya ummīsē hōi visēsō imō tattha // PiṇḍNi.648
---------------------------------------------------------------------
dāyavvamadāyavvaṁ ca dō'vi davvāiṁ dēi mīsēuṁ
ōyaṇakusuṇāīṇaṁ sāharaṇa tayaṇṇahiṁ chōḍhuṁ // PiṇḍNi.649
---------------------------------------------------------------------
tampiya sukkē sukkaṁ bhaṅgā cattāri jaha u sāharaṇō
appabahuē'vi caurō tahēva āinna'ṇāinnē // PiṇḍNi.650
---------------------------------------------------------------------
apariṇayampiya duvihaṁ davvē bhāvē ya duvihamekkekkaṁ
davvammi hōi chakkaṁ bhāvammi ya hōi sajjhilagā // PiṇḍNi.651
---------------------------------------------------------------------
jīvattammi avigaē apariṇayaṁ pariṇayaṁ gaē jīvē
diṭṭhantō duddhadahī iya apariṇayaṁ pariṇayaṁ taṁ ca // PiṇḍNi.652
---------------------------------------------------------------------
dugamāī sāmannē jai pariṇamaī u tattha ēgassa
dēmitti na sēsāṇaṁ apariṇayaṁ bhāvaō ēyaṁ // PiṇḍNi.653
---------------------------------------------------------------------
ēgēṇa vā'vi ēsiṁ maṇammi pariṇāmiyaṁ na iyarēṇaṁ
tampi hu hōi agijjhaṁ sajjhilagā sāmi sāhū vā // PiṇḍNi.654
---------------------------------------------------------------------
ghettavvamalēvakaḍaṁ lēvakaḍē mā hu pacchakammāī
na ya rasagēhipasaṅgō ia vuttē cōyagō bhaṇai // PiṇḍNi.655
---------------------------------------------------------------------
jai pacchakammadōsā havanti mā cēva bhuñjaū sayayaṁ
tavaniyamasañjamāṇaṁ cōyaga! hānī khamantassa // PiṇḍNi.656
---------------------------------------------------------------------
littanti bhāṇiūṇaṁ chammāsā hāyaē cautthaṁ tu
āyambilassa gahaṇaṁ asantharē appalēvaṁ tu // PiṇḍNi.657
---------------------------------------------------------------------
āyambilapāraṇaē chammāsa nirantaraṁ tu khaviūṇaṁ
jai na tarai chammāsē ēgadinūnaṁ taō kuṇau // PiṇḍNi.658
---------------------------------------------------------------------
ēvaṁ ekkekkadinaṁ āyambilapāraṇaṁ khavēūṇaṁ
divasē divasē giṇhau āyambilamēva nillēvaṁ // PiṇḍNi.659
---------------------------------------------------------------------
jai sē na jōgahānī sampai ēsē va hōi tō khamaō
khamaṇantarēṇa āyambilaṁ tu niyamaṁ tavaṁ kuṇai // PiṇḍNi.660
---------------------------------------------------------------------
heṭṭhāvaṇi kōlasagā sōvīragakūrabhōiṇō manuyā
jai tē'vi javenti tahā kiṁ nāma jaī na jāvinti? ।। gāhā-662 // PiṇḍNi.661
---------------------------------------------------------------------
tiya sīyaṁ samaṇāṇaṁ tiya uṇha gihīṇa tēṇa'ṇunnāyaṁ
takkāīṇaṁ gahaṇaṁ kaṭṭaramāīsu bhaiyavvaṁ // PiṇḍNi.662
---------------------------------------------------------------------
āhārauvahisejjā tinni vi uṇhā gihīṇa sīē'vi
tēṇa u jīrai tēsiṁ duhaō usiṇēṇa āhārō // PiṇḍNi.663
---------------------------------------------------------------------
ēyāiṁ ciya tinni vi jaīṇa sīyāiṁ honti gimhē vi
tēṇuvahammai aggī taō ya dōsā ajīrāī // PiṇḍNi.664
---------------------------------------------------------------------
ōyaṇa maṇḍaga sattuga kummāsārāya māsakalavaṭṭā
tūyarimasūramuggā māsā ya alēvaḍā sukkā // PiṇḍNi.665
---------------------------------------------------------------------
ubbhijjapijjakaṅgū takkollaṇasūvakañji kaḍhiyāī
ēē u appalēvā pacchākammaṁ tahiṁ bhaiyaṁ // PiṇḍNi.666
---------------------------------------------------------------------
khīra dahi jāu kaṭṭara tella ghēyaṁ phāṇiyaṁ sapiṇḍarasaṁ
iccāī bahulēvaṁ pacchākammaṁ tahiṁ niyamā // PiṇḍNi.667
---------------------------------------------------------------------
saṁsaṭṭhēyarahatthō mattō'viya davva sāvasēsiyaraṁ
ēēsu aṭṭha bhaṅgā niyamā gahaṇaṁ tu ōēsu // PiṇḍNi.668
---------------------------------------------------------------------
saccittē accittē mīsaga taha chaḍḍaṇē ya caubhaṅgō
caubhaṅgē paḍisēhō gahaṇē āṇāiṇō dōsā // PiṇḍNi.669
---------------------------------------------------------------------
usiṇassa chaḍḍaṇē dentaō va ḍajjhejjha kāyadāhō vā
sīyapaḍaṇammi kāyā paḍiē mahubinduāharaṇaṁ // PiṇḍNi.670
---------------------------------------------------------------------
nāmaṁ ṭhavaṇā daviē bhāvē ghāsēsaṇā muṇēyavvā
davvē macchāharaṇaṁ bhāvammi ya hōi pañcavihā // PiṇḍNi.671
---------------------------------------------------------------------
cariyaṁ va kappiyaṁ vā āharaṇaṁ duvihamēva nāyavvaṁ
atthassa sāhaṇaṭṭhā indhaṇamiva ōyaṇaṭṭhāē // PiṇḍNi.672
---------------------------------------------------------------------
aha maṁsammi pahīṇē jhāyantaṁ macchiyaṁ bhaṇai macchō
kiṁ jhāyasiṁ taṁ ēvaṁ? suṇa tāva jahā ahiriō'si // PiṇḍNi.673
---------------------------------------------------------------------
tibalāgamuhummukkō tikkhuttō valayāmuhē
tisattakkhuttō jālēṇaṁ sai chinnōdaē dahē // PiṇḍNi.674
---------------------------------------------------------------------
ēyārisaṁ mamaṁ sattaṁ saḍhaṁ ghaṭṭiyaghaṭṭaṇaṁ
icchasi galēṇa ghettuṁ ahō tē ahirīyayā // PiṇḍNi.675
---------------------------------------------------------------------
bāyālīsēsaṇasaṅkaḍammi gahaṇammi jīva! na hu chaliō
iṇhiṁ jaha na chalijjasi bhuñjantō rāgadōsēhiṁ // PiṇḍNi.676
---------------------------------------------------------------------
ghāsēsaṇā u bhāvē hōi pasatthā tahēva apasatthā
apasatthā pañcavihā tavvivarīyā pasatthāu // PiṇḍNi.677
---------------------------------------------------------------------
davvē bhāvē sañjōaṇā u davvē duhā u bahi antō
bhikkhaṁ ciya hiṇḍantō sañjōyantammi bāhiriyā ।। gāhā-679 // PiṇḍNi.678
---------------------------------------------------------------------
khīradahisūvakaṭṭaralambhē guḍasappivaḍagavāluṅkē
antō u tihā pāē lambaṇa vayaṇē vibhāsā u // PiṇḍNi.679
---------------------------------------------------------------------
saṁyōyaṇāē dōsō jō sañjōēi bhattapānaṁ tu
davvāī rasahēuṁ vāghāō tassimō hōi // PiṇḍNi.680
---------------------------------------------------------------------
sañjōyaṇā u bhāvē sañjōēūṇa tāni davvāiṁ
sañjōyai kammēṇaṁ kammēṇa bhavaṁ taō dukkhaṁ // PiṇḍNi.681
---------------------------------------------------------------------
pattē ya pauralambhē bhuttuvvariē ya sēsagamaṇaṭṭhā
diṭṭhō sañjōgō khalu ahakkamō tassimō hōi // PiṇḍNi.682
---------------------------------------------------------------------
rasahēuṁ paḍisiddhō saṁyōgō kappaē gilāṇaṭṭhā
jassa va abhattachandō suhōciō'bhāviō jō ya // PiṇḍNi.683
---------------------------------------------------------------------
battīsaṁ kira kavalā āhārō kucchipūraō bhaṇiō
purisassa mahiliyāē aṭṭhāvīsaṁ bhavē kavalā // PiṇḍNi.684
---------------------------------------------------------------------
ettō kiṇāi hīnaṁ addhaṁ addha'ddhagaṁ ca āhāraṁ
sāhussa binti dhīrā jāyāmāyaṁ ca ōmaṁ ca // PiṇḍNi.685
---------------------------------------------------------------------
pagāmaṁ ca nigāmaṁ ca jō paṇīyaṁ bhattapānamāhārē
aibahuyaṁ aibahusō pamāṇadōsō muṇēyavvō // PiṇḍNi.686
---------------------------------------------------------------------
battīsāi parēṇaṁ pagāma niccaṁ tamēva u nikāmaṁ
jaṁ puṇa galantanēhaṁ paṇīyamiti taṁ buhā benti // PiṇḍNi.687
---------------------------------------------------------------------
aibahuyaṁ aibahusō aippamāṇēṇa bhōyaṇaṁ bhottuṁ
hāejja va vāmijja va mārijja va taṁ ajīrantaṁ // PiṇḍNi.688
---------------------------------------------------------------------
bahuyātīyamaibahuṁ aibahusō tinni tinni va parēṇaṁ
taṁ ciya aippamāṇaṁ bhuñjai jaṁ vā atippantō // PiṇḍNi.689
---------------------------------------------------------------------
hiyāhārā miyāhārā appāhārā ya jē narā
na tē vijjā tigicchanti appāṇaṁ tē tigicchagā // PiṇḍNi.690
---------------------------------------------------------------------
telladahisamāōgā ahiō kharīdahikañjiyāṇaṁ ca
patthaṁ puṇa rōgaharaṁ na ya hēū hōi rōgassa // PiṇḍNi.691
---------------------------------------------------------------------
addhamasaṇassa savvañjanassa kujjā davassa dō bhāgē
vāūpaviyāraṇaṭṭhā chabbhāyaṁ ūṇayaṁ kujjā // PiṇḍNi.692
---------------------------------------------------------------------
sīō usiṇō sāhāraṇō ya kālō tihā muṇēyavvō
sāhāraṇammi kālē tatthāhārē imā mattā // PiṇḍNi.693
---------------------------------------------------------------------
sīē davassa ēgō bhattē cattāri ahava dō pāṇē
usiṇē davassa donni u tinni va sēsā u bhattassa // PiṇḍNi.694
---------------------------------------------------------------------
ēgō davassa bhāgō uvaṭṭhitō bhōyaṇassa dō bhāgā
vaḍḍhanti va hāyanti va dō dō bhāgā u ekkekkē ।। gāhā-696 // PiṇḍNi.695
---------------------------------------------------------------------
tattha u taiyacautthā donni ya aṇavaṭṭhiyā bhavē bhāgā
pañcamachaṭṭhō paḍhamō biiō vi avaṭṭhiyā bhāgā // PiṇḍNi.696
---------------------------------------------------------------------
taṁ hōi saiṅgālaṁ jaṁ āhārēi mucchiō santō
taṁ puṇa hōi sadhūmaṁ jaṁ āhārēi nindantō // PiṇḍNi.697
---------------------------------------------------------------------
aṅgārattamapattaṁ jalamāṇaṁ indhaṇaṁ sadhūmaṁ tu
aṅgāratti pavuccai taṁ ciya daḍḍhaṁ gaē dhūmē // PiṇḍNi.698
---------------------------------------------------------------------
rāgaggisampalittō bhuñjantō phāsuyampi āhāraṁ
niddaḍḍhaṅgālanibhaṁ karēi caraṇindhaṇaṁ khippaṁ // PiṇḍNi.699
---------------------------------------------------------------------
dōsaggīvi jalantō appattiyadhūmadhūmiyaṁ caraṇaṁ
aṅgāramittasarisaṁ jā na havai niddahī tāva // PiṇḍNi.700
---------------------------------------------------------------------
rāgēṇa saiṅgālaṁ dōsēṇa sadhūmagaṁ muṇēyavvaṁ
chāyālīsaṁ dōsā boddhavvā bhōyaṇavihīē // PiṇḍNi.701
---------------------------------------------------------------------
āhāranti tavassī vigaiṅgālaṁ ca vigayadhūmaṁ ca
jhāṇajjhayaṇanimittaṁ ēsuvaēsō pavayaṇassa // PiṇḍNi.702
---------------------------------------------------------------------
chahiṁ kāraṇēhiṁ sādhū āhārintō vi āyarai dhammaṁ
chahiṁ cēva kāraṇēhiṁ nijjūhintō vi āyarai // PiṇḍNi.703
---------------------------------------------------------------------
vēyaṇa vēyāvaccē iriyaṭṭhāē ya sañjamaṭṭhāē
taha pāṇavattiyāē chaṭṭhaṁ puṇa dhammacintāē // PiṇḍNi.704
---------------------------------------------------------------------
natthi chuhāē sarisā viyaṇā bhuñjejja tappasamaṇaṭṭhā
chāō vēyāvaccaṁ na tarai kāuṁ aō bhuñjē // PiṇḍNi.705
---------------------------------------------------------------------
iriaṁ navi sōhēī pēhāīaṁ ca sañjamaṁ kāuṁ
chāō vā parihāyai guṇaṇuppēhāsu a asattō // PiṇḍNi.706
---------------------------------------------------------------------
ahava ṇa kujjāhāraṁ chahiṁ ṭhāṇēhiṁ sañjaē
pacchā pacchimakālammi kāuṁ appakkhamaṁ khamaṁ // PiṇḍNi.707
---------------------------------------------------------------------
āyaṅkē uvasaggē titikkhayā bambhacēraguttīsu
pāṇidayā tavahēuṁ sarīravocchēyaṇaṭṭhāē // PiṇḍNi.708
---------------------------------------------------------------------
āyaṅkō jaramāī rāyāsannāyagāi uvasaggō
bambhavayapālaṇaṭṭhā pāṇidayā vāsamahiyāī // PiṇḍNi.709
---------------------------------------------------------------------
tavahēu cautthāī jāva u chammāsiō tavō hōi
chaṭṭhaṁ sarīravocchēyaṇaṭṭhayā hō aṇāhārō // PiṇḍNi.710
---------------------------------------------------------------------
sōlasa uggamadōsā sōlasa uppāyaṇāē dōsā u
dasa ēsaṇāē dōsā sañjōyaṇamāi pañcēva // PiṇḍNi.711
---------------------------------------------------------------------
ēsō āhāravihī jaha bhaṇiō savvabhāvadaṁsīhiṁ
dhammāvassagajōgā jēṇa na hāyanti taṁ kujjā // PiṇḍNi.712
---------------------------------------------------------------------
jā jayamāṇassa bhavē virāhaṇā suttavihisamaggassa
sā hōi nijjaraphalā ajjhatthavisōhijuttassa // PiṇḍNi.713
